task: MR03 补测之二：同一实例的并发启动守卫（A7 剩余项）
closes: gap-register A7 remainder (no concurrency guard on launching the same instance twice)

result.csharpFull: 807 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped - THREE consecutive clean full runs
result.productionChange: LocalApiService.HandleLaunchAsync: added a concurrency guard that rejects launching an instance already reported as running, placed BEFORE any network call or process dispatch
result.harnessFixed: LocalApiTestHarness.StartAsync now retries on a fresh port (up to 6 attempts) when HttpListenerException occurs

gapWasReal.before: HandleLaunchAsync only called MarkRunning (line 1677) and never checked IsRunning; the only check was in the DELETE guard (line 1243)
gapWasReal.consequence: the same instance could start two game processes writing the same saves, and MarkRunning overwrote the registry ("last one wins") so the delete guard then tracked only the newest PID
gapWasReal.placement: the guard runs before credential refresh, version resolution and process dispatch

redBaseline: remove the guard -> the "already running" test gets 500 "未找到版本 JSON" instead of 400 "已在运行" (1 failed)
selfFoundIssues: MY RED BACKUP WAS THE PRE-FIX STATE: restoring it undid the fix itself (I caught it because I checked 含守卫=False). Re-applied the guard and saved a proper POST-fix backup (green/LocalApiService.cs.fixed). RULE: for a RED on a fix, the backup must be the POST-fix state.

A PRE-EXISTING harness flake surfaced (6 then 2 intermittent bisect failures): HttpListenerException "另一个程序正在使用此文件" at LocalApiService.Start from LocalApiTestHarness. Bisect tests pass 17/17 alone. Root cause: AcquirePortAsync binds then RELEASES a TcpListener before HttpListener binds (classic TOCTOU), plus a deterministic port seed sequence; more service starts made it visible. Fixed by retrying on a fresh port (6 attempts). Verified: THREE consecutive full runs at 807/0 (was 6 -> 2 failures).
stillNotCovered: real Minecraft launch (needs a real game and Java) - this package only verifies the GUARD
runtime state is still in-process memory only: after a launcher restart it does not know the game is still running

STRICT ATOMICITY of the guard: it is check-then-dispatch, so a very narrow window remains between two concurrent HTTP requests. A per-instance launch reservation (TryBeginLaunch) was NOT implemented - recorded as remaining.
non-Windows: self-healing relies on Process.GetProcessById, verified on Windows only
